channel.title: InvestPR Media Monitoring
channel.description: Real investment activity this period: Five Below plans its first Puerto Rico stores for 2027, Zimmermann opened its first PR boutique, HPE will distribute the PR-built INbiz app across 40 Latin American markets, Disney is making San Juan a cruise homeport, and the Army Corps fast-tracked the long-delayed Carraízo reservoir sediment removal alongside a new 10-year Jones Act port deal and $80M more in federal down-payment assistance funds. Real risks to flag: tariff costs to the island roughly quadrupled to near $1 billion in 2025, PREPA leadership is in turmoil amid an FBI inquiry and ongoing bankruptcy proceedings, LUMA has made no progress restoring streetlights in nine municipalities nearly a decade after María, and some PR manufacturers are shifting operations to the Dominican Republic over cost competitiveness.
